points.text: fusion: two nuclei combine to form a (single) nucleus
fission: a (single) large nucleus divides to form (smaller) nuclei

Any one from: • fusion is initiated by (very) high temperatures • fission is initiated by neutron bombardment • resulting nuclei in fission are of similar size • (both processes) release energy • binding energy per nucleon increases • total binding energy increases • fission involves release of neutrons
